ideas.title: Basis signal — flat price
ideas.why: Spot 41-4-34 is -4.75¢ vs Dec 26, 1.14¢ weaker than normal for this week. A weak physical basis has tended to lead futures lower.

ideas.title: Pre-roll spread short (index roll + spec length)
ideas.why: Sell the Mar 27/May 27 spread 20 trading days before the Rogers index roll out of Mar 27 (roll starts 2027-01-28) if managed-money net length is in the top 20% of its 3-year range. Managed money is now +12.5% of open interest, 87th percentile.

ideas.title: Old-crop / new-crop spread from the first balance sheet
ideas.why: US 2026/27 ending stocks/use at the May WASDE was 28.1% (60th percentile of the last 10 seasons); latest 27.5% (60th, 10/2026). The rule skips seasons at or below the 30th percentile and exits if a later WASDE drops there.

ideas.title: Seasonal spread window
ideas.why: Sell the Mar/May spread at the close on 2027-04-30 and close it at the end of May. It has worked in 85% of years since 2000 and in 90% of the last 10.

ideas.title: Seasonal spread window
